_comment: COPY DECK for the Moon Whale Media promo campaign. Each product carries a stack of promos: id (stable - used for cooldown history), title (rendered ON the card under the wordmark), blurb (the post caption), and optionally its own screenshot/capture_url for a feature-specific page shot (falls back to the product's home shot). The picker chooses randomly among promos NOT posted within cooldown_days and never repeats a product back-to-back. Products whose screenshot is missing on disk are skipped (domains not live yet -> captures come from the Herd dev hosts via tools/capture-homes.mjs).
